finding.problem: At knownBy 1:38, the note says another Judah-line Shobal exists in this book. The fixed WEB does not introduce that other Shobal until 1CH 2:50 (identified in Caleb/Hur/Ephrathah genealogy as father of Kiriath-jearim; 2:52 continues his line). The note therefore exposes later same-name information before its textual occurrence and has no source record/sourceId supporting that comparison. This is a real reader-field/source-boundary issue even though the listed fact/source pair and 1:38 Wikipedia gate align.
